name: Form Kernel Plant
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected as wasting screen space): Kernel Plant Detail grid now renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from kernelPlantRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Depricarping Detail (screen-043, fixed moments earlier)/Pressing Detail (screen-042)/Threshing Detail (screen-041)/Cages Tipped Time (screen-012), no longer a structural difference from those grids

STRUCTURAL SHAPE MATCHES DEPRICARPING, UNAFFECTED by this revision: 9 reading columns per row (7 numeric + Downtime (Mins) as a separate numeric field + Findings as a separate free-text field), instead of Threshing's/Pressing's single free-text 'Downtime Reason' column -- isRowFilled()/validateDetailRows() in both the repo and this view check all 9 columns, with downtime_minutes and findings each independently sufficient to satisfy the minimum-one-row rule (which now also requires a selected Time-Slot, same as Depricarping/Pressing/Threshing)

Target Operasional reference table sourced from a STATIC constant (mobile/src/data/kernelPlantOperationalTargets.ts, created under screen-040) rather than a synced local reference table -- UNTOUCHED by this revision, same judgment call already documented for Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping; renders 3 columns (Equipment / Parameter, Target Benchmark, Corrective Action Plan) matching Threshing's/Pressing's shape, NOT Depricarping's 4-column shape

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 dari 9 kolom bacaan terisi) validated at FE + repo level (kernelPlantRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws KernelPlantDetailRequiredError) -- NOT enforced by the server model's KernelPlantRecord::booted() saving guard, which only checks row EXISTENCE (now meaningfully true only once the user has added at least one row, since rows are no longer pre-created), same pattern already fixed for Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23) -- the one structural difference from Cages Tipped Time's availableHourOptions(), otherwise the floor/exclusion logic is identical to Depricarping's/Pressing's/Threshing's fixed version

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. ripple-mill-1-{index}, downtime-minutes-{index}, findings-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide

Time-Slot per row is now a SearchableSelect.vue instance (was a read-only label) -- mirrors FormDepricarpingView.vue exactly, WITH pendingDeletionIds for existing (has-id) rows removed via Hapus baris

Playwright e2e suite (mobile/tests/e2e/form-kernel-plant.spec.ts) REVISED 2026-08-24 alongside this fix to exercise Tambah baris/Hapus baris and the Time-Slot <select> (was 'always 24 rows, drive New Data flow directly'); syntax verified via `playwright test --list` (10 scenarios), not executed against a live dev server + backend in this environment, matching the sibling stations' now-standard verification depth for this revision.

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormKernelPlantView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('kernel_plant_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/kernel-plant-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03); di sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil per record di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('kernel-plant', mill, date) di KernelPlantRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave() mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; respons server 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) mengisi rejection dengan pesan server, sedangkan offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap {synced:false, rejection:null} dan diam. onSimpan() FormKernelPlantView menyimpan pesan itu ke writeThroughRejection, menampilkan ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label="") berjudul 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' dengan pesan server, dan baru bernavigasi ke monitor-kernel-plant saat dialog ditutup (Mengerti atau klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal, tidak ada rollback. Test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts ('reports the server message when the push is rejected with 422 PERIOD_CLOSED' + kasus diam); tidak ada test per-form untuk dialog ini di layar Kernel Plant — pola identik dengan Threshing yang dicakup mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/form-kernel-plant.spec.ts 10/10 lulus — kini dijalankan nyata terhadap dev server + backend (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan ulang di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): tabel Target Operasional berada di CollapsibleSection yang tertutup secara default (disengaja, 2026-08-25) — spec kini membukanya dulu sebelum meng-assert isi tabel.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): (1) label catatan header 'Note' → 'Catatan' dengan id eksplisit field-note di FormKernelPlantView.vue (dikunci mobile/tests/noteLabelConsistency.spec.ts). (2) kernelPlantRecordRepo.createDraft() mengisi `date` dengan tanggal LOKAL 'YYYY-MM-DD' via todayLocalDateString() (mobile/src/utils/localDate.ts), bukan ISO UTC; nilai lama bersufiks zona dinormalisasi sekali oleh localSchema.normalizeLegacyUtcDates() (mobile/tests/localDate.sqljs.spec.ts). (3) write-through kini benar-benar aktif saat immediate_sync_enabled=true — millSettingRepo.getMillSetting() sebelumnya tidak men-SELECT kolom itu (mobile/tests/millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts, writeThroughSync.spec.ts). (4) syncService.pushUniformRow mengirim `date` lokal, menyimpan alasan penolakan server ke kolom sync_error (ditampilkan Data Preview sebagai 'Gagal sinkron: <alasan>'), dan sinkron manual memakai Production Line stasiun record (mobile/tests/syncService.sqljs.spec.ts). (5) ConfirmDialog di-teleport ke <body> (z-index 1200) sehingga dialog Back/Clear/penolakan tidak tertutup elemen lain (mobile/tests/DialogTeleport.spec.ts). Angka test_results tidak diubah.
